slug: 2026-03-24 Gambia Police must transition from paper documentation to digitalised mode - IGP

facts.fact: The Inspector General of Police, Seedy Mukhtar Touray, told his quarterly media briefing at Police Headquarters in Banjul that the Gambia Police Force needs to move from paper-based documentation to a digitalised mode; the briefing is undated, so the document's published date is used.

The Inspector General of Police described the force's documentation as paper-based and digitalisation of police workflow and records management as something still to come, naming no digital system in use; the briefing is undated, so the document's published date is used.

note: The statement is about the force as a whole; it names no station, no system and no plan or budget for the transition.
